pages.text: Mahou Tsukai is the T4 magic system — body enhancement magic that integrates deeply with the class system.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Mahou Tsukai's spell system is the endgame magic path for Archmage and Battlemage. Enhancement magic (buffing self and others) and blade techniques (melee empowerment) are the primary systems.$(br2)$(bold)Initiation:$() Mahou Tsukai requires a Gaia Spirit Fragment (Botania Gaia Guardian drop) for initiation. This is the bridge between T3 and T4 magic.

$(bold)Class synergy:$() Archmage's Arcane Mastery stacks with Mahou Tsukai's magic power system. The interaction at T4 Archmage + Mahou Tsukai investment is among the highest raw damage outputs in the pack.

Craft the $(bold)Mahou Tsukai Guidebook$() for the full reference — magic circle construction, spell research, and the Mahou stat system.$(br2)Access: hold a Mahou Tsukai item and check JEI -- the mod's guide is in-mod, no separate book.
